_about: Hand-maintained registry of instrument fixes. tools/build_results_index.py reads it and marks every run that loaded an affected stepper on code WITHOUT the fix as STALE_PENDING_REVALIDATION (view v_stale_runs). Descriptive only: it never blocks a run. Add one entry per fix; record re-validations under `revalidated` as {old_run_id: new_run_id_or_doc}. Runs listed in `not_affected` are exempted with a reason. See docs/instrument_integrity/SOLVER_AND_RUNTIME_CHANGELOG.md.

fixes.summary: Order ~0.6 instead of 4; psi error 8.5% at dt=0.005, T=2 (N=48). Quantitative pre-fix ETDRK4 results need re-validation.
